title: He Made $60K His First Month With This Boring Business
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Mike promotes Old Cap Coatings and invites viewers to contact him for startup help, so the episode also serves as self-promotion.

idea.name: Decorative concrete floor coatings
idea.one_liner: Install decorative flake coatings on residential garage floors and other concrete surfaces, charging by square foot.
idea.customer: Mostly homeowners with larger garages; also some warehouses, shops, churches, and other property owners.
idea.offer: Grind and prepare concrete, apply base coat and decorative flake, then seal with a top coat. Garage floors are the main service; patios, basements, walkways, and commercial spaces are also mentioned.
idea.revenue_model: Project fees, generally priced per square foot, with optional add-ons such as moving garage contents.

acquisition_channels.details: Meta ads on Facebook and Instagram, plus Google ads and Google Local Services Ads; Mike said Meta generated most leads.
A $200 referral program and early word-of-mouth through friends and church.
Google Business Profile and reviews, which Mike said they worked to improve.

ideas.delivery: A crew transports grinders and coating materials to the customer's site, prepares the concrete, applies base coat and flake, then seals it with a top coat. Most jobs are completed by two field workers in a day; Mike oversees, while his brother handles sales.

ideas.other_uk_rules: For a UK operation, UK GDPR applies to lead and customer records; PECR applies to marketing consent and cookies. Installers need appropriate health-and-safety controls, including COSHH for coating products, and UK employment obligations apply to hired crews.
